subject: Demo recap + Trial blueprint — 6-week readiness & acceptance checklist
messages:
From: Amit Shah <amit@novalytics.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Thank you — Demo recap and ask: proposed POC scope

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — the team at Novalytics found the walkthrough of the embeddings + reranking flow really helpful. Quick recap from our side: we want to pilot Redwood behind our support search to reduce time-to-resolution for tier-1 tickets and automate suggested replies for common issues. High-level goals we discussed:

- Improve first-touch deflection by 15%
- Surface correct KB article in first 3 results >= 85% of the time
- Average latency for a user-facing query < 300ms (p95 target)

We're ready to run a 4–6 week pilot to validate those metrics. Can you send a proposed trial blueprint that includes: success criteria, required artifacts from our side, timeline, and who from Redwood will own each milestone?

Also flag any compliance or data-handling constraints (we are SOC2 in-scope and need a DPA).

Thanks — happy to get a kickoff on the calendar this week.

— Amit
Amit Shah | Head of AI Platform | Novalytics
(attachment: support-sample-manifest.csv)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Thank you — Demo recap and ask: proposed POC scope

Hi Amit — really appreciate the clear goals. Attached is a concise trial blueprint and a data ingestion checklist to make the kickoff frictionless. Summary below; full details are attached (redwood-poc-blueprint.pdf, data-ingest-checklist.xlsx).

POC Overview (6-week recommended run):
- Week 0: Kickoff & access (data manifest, sample export, security review) — owner: Novalytics (Amit) / Redwood intake: Mina
- Week 1–2: Data ingest + vector index build in a sandbox (redwood-managed env, us-west-2) — owner: Redwood Eng (Mina) + Novalytics infra contact
- Week 3: Evaluation run (500 representative queries from support logs) — owner: Novalytics Product + Redwood Analytics (Ben)
- Week 4: Iteration (prompt / rerank tuning, quantization suggestions) — owner: Redwood Eng (Mina)
- Week 5: Acceptance run & SLA gating (latency/cost/accuracy) — owner: Novalytics Product + Redwood Customer Success (Ben)
- Week 6: Handoff & next steps (decision: extend to dedicated capacity / procurement) — owner: Novalytics Leadership + Redwood Sales (Ben)

Success criteria (pass/fail for go/no-go):
- Relevance: top-3 result contains a correct KB link >= 85% (eval set: 500 queries)
- Latency: p95 end-to-end <= 300ms for 95% of queries under test workload
- Quality: Suggested reply precision >= 75% on sampled tickets
- Operational: Automated ingest pipeline can update index within 30 minutes for daily delta loads
- Cost: incremental cost per 1k queries should be < $15 to meet procurement thresholds

Evaluation plan & metrics:
- We'll run two blind batches (A/B): baseline (current search) vs Redwood-powered rerank.
- Metrics captured: top-K accuracy, MRR, p95 latency, token cost per query, failed calls per 1k requests.
- Owner for metric capture and dashboard: Ben Carter (Customer Success/Sales ops) — we will provide a shared dashboard and short daily syncs during evaluation window.

Security/compliance checklist (high level):
- DPA required (we can sign your template or provide ours)
- SOC2 report and network diagram: provided on request (Redwood will share link)
- Data retention: default sandbox retention 30 days; production retention configurable per Novalytics policy

Required artifacts from Novalytics to start:
1) sample export (schema + ~500 representative queries) — attachment: support-sample-manifest.csv
2) expected KB mapping and sample tickets for acceptance test
3) contact for infra/VPC peering if you want private deployment

Next steps (short list):
1) Confirm kickoff slot — we propose Tue Aug 24, 10:00–11:00 PT
2) Share sample export + manifest by EOD Wed Aug 19
3) Sign DPA or confirm the DocuSign link below

DocuSign (DPA draft): https://www.docusign.com/NPV-DPA-Novalytics
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/9342

I've kept the blueprint intentionally terse so your team can review quickly. If the timeline looks tight, we can stretch to 8 weeks — happy to align.

Best,

Mina Haddad

Thanks Mina — looping in myself to coordinate the trial cadence and billing estimate. A few operational notes from our side:

- We'll provision a sandbox in us-west-2 with a small dedicated pool (2x A10G equiv) for the evaluation; that should keep p95 latency in the range you need for 95% of queries.
- Cost estimate for the 6-week pilot (data ingest + 500 eval queries/day): ~$4,200 (inclusive of compute and index storage). I can break this out in the kickoff.
- If you prefer a private deployment behind your VPC, we can surface a separate quote — that will add setup time (~3–5 business days) and connectivity review.

Confirming the proposed kickoff: Tue Aug 24, 10:00 PT works for me. I'll own the daily syncs and the dashboarding so we can make go/no-go calls quickly.
